receipt.public_excerpt: The Attorney General shall prioritize the enforcement of 18 U.S.C. 1028, 18 U.S.C. 1030, 18 U.S.C. 1343, and all other applicable Federal criminal laws against anyone who utilizes AI to illegally access or damage a computer without authorization, or who utilizes AI while engaged in such illegal access to further any other crime.

evidence_items.explanation: This primary government disclosure directs enforcement against AI-enabled computer crime before the forecast. It prevents assuming complete federal inaction, but neither establishes implementation nor determines what additional action Marcus meant by steps up.
